title: BikeZ-ETH - A Mass-Cycling Trajectory Dataset from a Controlled Experiment
publisher: Riehl, Kevin (ETH Zurich); El-Baklish, Shaimaa K. (ETH Zurich); Ni, Ying-Chuan (ETH Zurich); Kouvelas, Anastasios (ETH Zurich); Makridis, Michail (ETH Zurich)
author_preprocessing: Twenty-one TXT sequences extracted by computer vision/Kalman processing; large original video collection omitted.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Keep complete sequences and cyclist IDs together where available. Twenty-eight cyclists appear across sequences; tracker occlusions/identity ambiguity constrain individual-level inference.
independent_groups: complete sequence and cyclist where IDs permit
